fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Grey paint looks fairly clean and glossy overall, with light dust and some dullness on the lower doors and rocker panels
Brake dust on the front wheel face, spokes and lug nut area
Shine and visible wear on the steering wheel leather rim
Light creasing and dull, slightly worn surface on the red driver seat bolster and cushion
Dust on the dashboard top and around the center console
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Macan S and it looks like a nice car. The red leather on the driver seat and the steering wheel could use a deep clean and condition, and the wheels are carrying some brake dust. We do pre-sale details that come to you and can freshen up the interior and exterior before buyers see it. Would you like a quote?
